metadata.title: Fix admin login 302 redirect loop behind reverse proxies that forward the full request path
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Fixes #2806

---

## 📌 Summary
Fix admin login 302 redirect loop behind reverse proxies that forward the full request path.

`AdminAuthMiddleware` detected admin routes using a `root_path`-aware fallback, but the exempt-path check for `/admin/login` did not have the same fallback. When `scope["path"]` contained the full prefixed path, the login page was not recognized as exempt, causing the middleware to auth-check it and redirect back to itself in a loop.

## 💡 Fix Description
**`mcpgateway/main.py`**

- **`AdminAuthMiddleware`**: Normalize `scope_path` by stripping the `root_path` prefix once at the top of `dispatch()`. Both `is_admin_route` and `is_exempt` now operate on the route-only path, eliminating the asymmetry.
- **`DocsAuthMiddleware`**: Same normalization, replacing the dual-check pattern for consistency.

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Lint suite                            | `make lint`          |    pass    |
| Unit tests                            | `make test`          |    pass    |

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed

commits.message:
fix: normalize scope_path in auth middleware to prevent redirect loop behind proxy

AdminAuthMiddleware had an asymmetry: is_admin_route checked both
scope_path and the root_path-prefixed url.path, but is_exempt only
checked scope_path. When a reverse proxy forwards the full path without
stripping the prefix, scope_path contains the prefix and the exempt
check for /admin/login fails — causing a 302 redirect loop on the
login page.

Extract _normalize_scope_path() helper that strips root_path prefix
from scope_path once at the top of dispatch() so all downstream checks
use the route-only path consistently. Apply the same normalization to
DocsAuthMiddleware.

Guards:
- root_path="/" is ignored to avoid stripping leading slash
- Path boundary check prevents partial prefix matches
  (e.g. root_path="/app" won't strip from "/application/admin")

Closes #2806

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
